stories.headline: China censors videos showing deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border
stories.summary: Flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border have killed hundreds, with Nepal's death toll approaching 800, yet Chinese authorities are removing videos of the disaster from circulation. The region continues to face hazards from unstable terrain, including recent road collapses from landslides, while rescue operations work to reach people trapped in tunnels and recover missing persons.

stories.headline: Palestinian mother in agony as Israeli attack kills her son
stories.summary: A Palestinian boy was killed in a recent Israeli military operation in the West Bank, leaving his mother grieving the loss. The incident reflects broader tensions in the region, where violence involving Israeli forces and settlers against Palestinians has intensified in recent months.

stories.headline: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
stories.summary: Icelandic voters have rejected a proposal to resume EU membership negotiations, reflecting persistent public skepticism about joining the bloc despite economic and security considerations. The referendum result means Iceland will not pursue formal accession talks at this time, though the country maintains its existing relationship with the EU through the European Economic Area.

stories.headline: Death toll from Russian strike on Ukrainian arms depot rises to 38
stories.summary: A Russian strike on an ammunition depot near Kyiv has killed at least 37-38 people, making it one of the deadliest attacks in Ukraine this year. The target's military significance suggests the strike was aimed at degrading Ukrainian supply capabilities, though civilian casualties appear to have resulted from the impact.

stories.headline: At least seven dead after ferry capsizes off Northern Cyprus
stories.summary: A ferry carrying approximately 260-270 passengers capsized off the coast of Northern Cyprus, resulting in at least seven confirmed deaths. Rescue operations continue as authorities work to account for all passengers and crew aboard the vessel.

stories.headline: The Trump administration claims America will soon get a majority of its oil from Venezuela with new deal
stories.summary: The Trump administration has announced an oil agreement with Venezuela that would supply a majority of American oil imports under a 25-year arrangement. The deal faces opposition from multiple Venezuelan political factions and involves a controversial executive seeking to attract international investors.

stories.headline: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
stories.summary: A shooting at a rave in Switzerland has killed a 22-year-old woman and wounded five others, prompting an active manhunt for the perpetrator. The incident represents a rare outbreak of gun violence at a public gathering in a country where such events are uncommon.

stories.headline: Iran’s Khamenei calls for Gulf unity as Hormuz tensions persist
stories.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei is calling for regional cooperation among Gulf states amid ongoing tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most critical shipping routes. His appeal frames Western powers, particularly the US and Israel, as obstacles to Muslim unity and suggests coordinated regional action as a response to external pressures.

stories.headline: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
stories.summary: A British woman has been killed in a stabbing at a German railway station, with authorities detaining a suspect in connection with the incident. The circumstances surrounding the attack remain under investigation as German police work to establish a motive.

stories.headline: Dozens of soldiers arrested after apparent coup attempt in Niger’s capital
stories.summary: Soldiers staged a mutiny in Niger's capital, prompting security forces to intervene and arrest dozens of participants in what authorities describe as a contained incident. The military-led government reasserted control over key installations, including an airbase, though the underlying tensions within the armed forces remain unclear.
